slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Unlimited is a word worth pinning down before you sign anything, because plenty of providers use it and then quietly meter you. For us it means unlimited support requests. If your team needs help, they ask, however often that turns out to be. Nobody is counting tickets and nobody gets a bill at the end of the month for asking too many questions.

Paragraph 3
slots.default: Unlimited support requests. If your team needs help, they ask, however often that turns out to be. Nobody is counting tickets and nobody gets a bill at the end of the month for asking too many questions.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: A project is still a project. Migrating you to a new system, fitting out a new office, rolling out fifty new laptops or building something from scratch is scoped and quoted separately, because the effort involved has nothing to do with day-to-day support and pretending otherwise would either cost you more every month or cost us the ability to do it well.

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: Hardware and licences are yours. We will advise, procure and manage them, often at better pricing than you would get direct, but the kit and the subscriptions are not hidden inside the support fee. We would rather tell you where the line sits now than have that conversation when something matters.
